name: Braintrust
tagline: Evaluation and observability platform for LLM apps and agents, with experiments, scorers and tracing.
bestFor: Product teams running evals in CI on every pull request
description: Braintrust runs offline experiments against datasets, scores results with code or LLM-as-judge scorers, and traces production calls for online scoring. The Starter plan is free with unlimited users; Pro costs $249 per month flat plus usage.
pros: Free Starter plan includes unlimited users, projects, datasets and experiments
Pro includes 5 GB of processed data, 50K scores and $100 of model credits per month
Official GitHub Action posts eval results as a pull request comment
Trace-level scorers can check tool usage, tool failures and step budgets in agent runs
cons: Platform is proprietary; only the autoevals scorer library is MIT-licensed
Starter keeps data for 14 days and Pro for 30 days
SAML SSO and self-hosted data plane are Enterprise only
freePlanDetails: Starter: unlimited users, 1 GB processed data, 10K scores, $10 of model credits per month, 14-day retention, 1 human review score per project. No credit card required.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Overage: $4/GB processed data, $2.50 per 1,000 scores; community support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat monthly platform fee for the whole team (not per seat) plus usage: 5 GB included then $3/GB, 50K scores then $1.50 per 1,000, 30-day retention then $0.50/GB/month. No annual price published. 6-12 months free for qualifying startups.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; on-prem or hosted deployment, SAML SSO, custom retention, BAA for HIPAA, premium support with SLAs.

integrations: Self-hosted data plane via Terraform on AWS, GCP and Azure; GitHub Actions

name: Langfuse
tagline: Open-source LLM engineering platform for tracing, evaluation and prompt management.
bestFor: Teams that want an MIT-licensed tool they can self-host
description: Langfuse combines tracing, datasets and experiments, LLM-as-a-judge evaluators and versioned prompt management, and can be self-hosted for free under the MIT license. Cloud plans start with a free Hobby tier, and Core costs $29 per month flat plus usage.
pros: Core features are MIT-licensed and free to self-host with unlimited usage
Cloud Core and above include unlimited users
GitHub Action (langfuse/experiment-action) fails a pull request when an experiment regresses
Evaluators receive tool calls as structured fields for agent evaluation
cons: Hobby plan is limited to 2 users and 30 days of data access
SOC 2, ISO 27001 reports and HIPAA BAA start on the $199 Pro plan
Enterprise SSO on Pro needs the $300/month Teams add-on
freePlanDetails: Hobby (cloud): 50k units per month, 30 days data access, 2 users, 1 annotation queue, 2 alerts; no credit card. Self-hosted open source: free with unlimited usage.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: 50k units/month, no overage allowed; community support via GitHub.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Flat per month, unlimited users. 100k units/month included, then $8 per 100k units (falling to $6 per 100k above 50M). 90 days data access. Yearly commitment available above a minimum contract value (amount not published).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat per month plus the same unit overage. 3 years data access, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, HIPAA BAA available. Optional Teams add-on $300/month adds Enterprise SSO and a Slack channel.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Flat per month plus unit overage, or a yearly commitment with custom volume pricing. Enterprise SSO, support and uptime SLAs.

plans.name: Self-hosted Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, additive to a ClickHouse commercial plan; adds project-level RBAC, retention policies, audit logs and support SLA.

integrations: OpenTelemetry; self-host with Docker Compose or Kubernetes (Helm); GitHub Actions

name: LangSmith
tagline: LangChain's platform for tracing, evaluating and deploying LLM agents.
bestFor: Teams building agents with LangChain or LangGraph
description: LangSmith traces LLM and agent runs, runs offline and online evaluations with LLM-as-judge evaluators, and integrates with pytest and Vitest for evals in CI. The Developer plan is free for 1 seat, and Plus costs $39 per seat per month plus trace usage.
pros: Free Developer plan includes 5k base traces per month
pytest and Vitest/Jest integrations run evals as test cases
Trajectory LLM-as-judge evaluators for agent runs via OpenEvals/agentevals
SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR and ISO 27001 listed
cons: Proprietary; self-hosting only on Enterprise
Priced per seat, and Developer allows only 1 seat
Base traces are kept 14 days; the price for extended (180-day) retention is not published
freePlanDetails: Developer: 1 seat, 5k base traces per month, then pay as you go; community support.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: 1 seat; 5k base traces/month, then pay as you go (per-trace rate not stated on pricing page).

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Per seat per month, unlimited seats; 10k base traces/month included, then pay as you go. Deployment (Agent Server, Fleet) billed in LSUs at $1 per LSU. Up to $10,000 in credits for VC-backed startups.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing invoiced annually upfront; cloud, hybrid or self-hosted; custom SSO; support SLA.

sources.label: LangSmith docs: run evaluations with pytest

name: Arize Phoenix
tagline: Source-available tracing and evaluation tool for LLM apps, with a hosted Arize AX tier.
bestFor: Teams that want OpenTelemetry tracing and evals they can run locally
description: Phoenix traces LLM apps with OpenTelemetry, runs LLM and code evals, and manages versioned datasets, experiments and prompts; it can be self-hosted with Docker or Kubernetes. The hosted Arize AX product has a free tier, and AX Pro costs $50 per month.
pros: Phoenix self-hosts free with Docker or a Helm chart
AX Free includes 25k spans, 1 GB ingestion and unlimited users
Prebuilt LLM-as-judge evaluators for tool selection and tool parameters
pytest integration and GitHub Actions example for CI checks
cons: Phoenix is under the Elastic License 2.0, which is source-available, not OSI open source
AX Pro allows 50k spans and 30-day retention; overage rates are not published
HIPAA and enterprise SSO are AX Enterprise only
freePlanDetails: Phoenix: free to self-host. AX Free (SaaS): 25k trace spans and 1 GB ingestion per month, 15-day retention, unlimited users; no credit card.

plans.name: Phoenix (self-hosted)
plans.notes: Source-available under Elastic License 2.0; you run the infrastructure.

plans.name: AX Free
plans.notes: 25k spans/month, 1 GB ingestion, 15-day retention, unlimited users; community support.

plans.name: AX Pro
plans.notes: Listed as $50 per month with unlimited users (no per-seat price stated). 50k spans/month, 10 GB ingestion, 30-day retention, email support. Overage rates not published.

plans.name: AX Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; SaaS or self-hosted; HIPAA, enterprise SSO, dedicated support.

integrations: OpenTelemetry (OpenInference); Docker, Kubernetes (Helm); data regions US, EU or CA

sources.label: Arize blog: how to evaluate tool-calling agents

name: Comet Opik
tagline: Open-source LLM tracing, evaluation and prompt optimization platform from Comet.
bestFor: Small teams that want a low-cost hosted plan or free self-hosting
description: Opik traces LLM calls, runs LLM-as-a-judge metrics on datasets and experiments, includes a prompt playground, and integrates with pytest for CI; it is Apache 2.0 licensed. The cloud Free plan covers 25k spans per month, and Pro costs $19 per month flat.
pros: Apache 2.0 licensed, self-hosts with Docker Compose or Helm
Pro is $19/month for up to 50 team members and 100k spans
Built-in trajectory accuracy metric for agent runs
Free cloud plan keeps data for 60 days
cons: Free cloud plan has no span overage; extra spans need Pro
SSO and compliance certifications are listed only on Enterprise
Free and Pro cloud data is hosted in the US region only
freePlanDetails: Free cloud: 25k spans per month, 60-day retention, up to 10 team members. Open source self-hosted: unlimited spans and users.
trial: Pro free trial offered (length not stated)

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Self-hosted; unlimited spans, retention and users; community support.

plans.name: Free Cloud
plans.notes: 25k spans/month, 60-day retention, up to 10 members; no overage.

plans.name: Pro Cloud
plans.notes: Flat per month (not per seat), up to 50 members. 100k spans/month, then $5 per 100k spans; extended retention (60 to 400 days) $29 per 100k spans. Email support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; unlimited spans; on-prem or managed deployment; SSO (SAML, LDAP); 2-hour response SLA.

name: Confident AI (DeepEval)
tagline: Hosted evaluation and tracing platform built on the open-source DeepEval framework.
bestFor: Python teams writing LLM tests with pytest-style metrics
description: Confident AI adds test-run tracking, tracing, datasets, prompt versioning and online evals on top of DeepEval, an Apache 2.0 framework with G-Eval and agent metrics such as tool correctness and task completion. The Free plan covers 2 seats, and Starter costs $200 per month flat per organization.
pros: DeepEval is Apache 2.0 and lists about 40 metrics, including G-Eval and tool correctness
Paid plans are flat per organization with unlimited seats
Tests run in any CI system, with GitHub Actions setup documented
Starter includes online evals, annotation queues and chat simulations
cons: The Confident AI platform itself is proprietary; only DeepEval is open source
Free plan allows 5 test runs per week and 1 project
SSO and SOC 2 start on the $2,000/month Team plan
freePlanDetails: 2 seats, 1 project, 1 GB-month of trace spans, 5 test runs per week; extra spans dropped; no credit card.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2 seats, 1 project, 1 GB-month spans, 5 test runs/week.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Flat per organization, unlimited seats, 5 projects, 5 GB-months included, then $1 per GB-month ingested or retained. Annual billing discounted but price not published.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Flat per organization, unlimited projects, 75 GB-months included, then $1 per GB-month. Adds SSO, SOC 2, custom RBAC, dataset/metric versioning.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom contract; dedicated on-prem deployment, HIPAA, data residency, 24x7 support.

integrations: pytest (deepeval test run), GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry (confident-trace)

name: Promptfoo
tagline: Open-source CLI for testing prompts, models and agents, with red teaming.
bestFor: Developers who want config-file evals and security tests in CI
description: Promptfoo is an MIT-licensed CLI and library that runs test cases against prompts, models and agents with deterministic, model-graded (llm-rubric) and trajectory assertions, and also does red teaming. The Community edition is free; Enterprise and On-Premise plans are quote-only.
pros: MIT-licensed; runs locally or self-hosted for free
Official GitHub Action runs before-and-after evals on pull requests
Trajectory assertions check tool use, tool order and step counts from traces
Community edition includes 10k red-team probes per month
cons: Paid plans have no published prices
Team sharing, SSO and continuous monitoring are Enterprise only
OpenAI agreed to acquire Promptfoo in March 2026; both say the project stays open source
freePlanDetails: Community: all LLM evaluation features, all providers, vulnerability scanning, 10k red-team probes per month; community support.

plans.name: Community
plans.notes: Free forever; run locally or self-host.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Priced by team size and needs; team sharing, continuous monitoring, SSO, API access, managed cloud; extra probes available.

plans.name: On-Premise
plans.notes: Enterprise features deployed on your own infrastructure with a dedicated runner and deployment engineer.

integrations: GitHub Actions and other CI systems; OpenTelemetry (OTLP) tracing; all major model providers

name: W&B Weave
tagline: Weights & Biases toolkit for tracing, scoring and comparing LLM apps and agents.
bestFor: Teams already using Weights & Biases for model training
description: Weave traces functions and LLM calls, runs evaluations with code or LLM-judge scorers over versioned datasets, and versions prompt objects; the SDK is Apache 2.0. The Free plan includes 1 GB of Weave ingestion per month, and Pro starts at $60 per month.
pros: SDK is Apache 2.0 licensed
Free plan includes up to 5 seats and 1 GB of Weave ingestion per month
Pro has a 30-day free trial
Agent evaluation tutorial and Evaluation Playground for side-by-side model comparison
cons: Pro includes only 1.5 GB of ingestion, then $0.10 per MB
SSO, HIPAA option and dedicated deployment are Enterprise only
Pricing now sits on CoreWeave's Forge page, bundled with other W&B products
freePlanDetails: Up to 5 model seats, 5 GB storage and 1 GB Weave ingestion per month; email support.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 seats, 1 GB/month Weave ingestion, 5 GB storage.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starts at $60/month billed monthly (flat starting price, up to 10 model seats). 1.5 GB/month Weave ingestion, then $0.10/MB; 100 GB storage, then $0.03/GB. No annual price published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-based with annual commitment discounts; extra Weave ingestion $0.20/MB; SSO, HIPAA option, dedicated deployment.

tagline: Platform for prompt experimentation, agent simulation, evaluation and observability.
bestFor: Teams testing chat and voice agents with simulated users
description: Maxim AI covers prompt playground and versioning, evaluator store with LLM-as-a-judge evaluators, agent and voice simulations, and production log tracing with online evals. The Developer plan is free for up to 3 seats, and Professional costs $29 per seat per month.

Simulated multi-turn sessions with personas to test agents
GitHub Action (maximhq/actions) runs test runs in CI
14-day free trial on Professional and Business
cons: Proprietary platform; only the Bifrost gateway is open source
Short log retention: 3 days free, 7 days Professional, 30 days Business
SSO, in-VPC deployment and SOC 2/HIPAA are Enterprise only

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per seat per month, billed monthly; unlimited workspaces, 500k logs/month, then $1 per 10k logs; 30-day retention, RBAC, private Slack support.

name: Laminar
tagline: Open-source tracing, evaluation and trace analysis platform for AI agents.
bestFor: Teams debugging long-running and browser agents
description: Laminar is an Apache 2.0 platform with OpenTelemetry tracing, browser session replay, SDK and CLI evaluations, datasets, labeling queues and an LLM-based Signals feature that flags issues in traces. The Free plan includes 1 GB of data, and Starter costs $30 per month flat with unlimited seats.
pros: Apache 2.0 licensed; self-hosts with Docker Compose or Helm
Starter is $30/month with unlimited seats and projects
Agent evaluations run in real environments and capture full trajectories
Session replay for Browser Use and Stagehand agents
cons: No built-in LLM-as-judge scorer documented; you write evaluator functions
Free plan allows 1 seat, 1 project and 7 days of data access
Signals analysis is billed separately by tokens on paid plans
freePlanDetails: 1 GB data with no overage, 7-day data access, 1 project, 1 seat; no Signals; community support.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 GB data, no overage; Discord community support.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Flat per month, unlimited seats and projects. 3 GB included, then $2/GB; 30-day data access; Signals billed at $0.05 per input Mtok, $0.30 per output Mtok; $5 one-time Signals credit; email support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat per month, unlimited seats. 10 GB included, then $1.50/GB; 6-month data access; same Signals token rates; Slack support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom limits, on-premise deployment, dedicated support.
